categories.label: Housing and Living Arrangements
categories.description: Housing and living arrangements that increase exposure to hazards, displacement risk, or limit control over mitigation and recovery.

indicators.label: Houses Built Before 1990
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of occupied housing units built before 1990.
indicators.description: Older housing can increase displacement risk and recovery cost.

indicators.label: Houses Built Before 1970
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of occupied housing units built before 1970.
indicators.description: Older housing can increase displacement risk and recovery cost.

indicators.label: Population in Group Quarters
indicators.calculationDescription: Number of people living in institutional group quarters.
indicators.description: Shared or institutional settings can create greater challenges during evacuation and sheltering due to facility-specific procedures, living arrangements, and support needs.

indicators.metric: Institutionalized population: Correctional facilities for adults
indicators.label: Group quarters: Correctional facilities
Renter Occupied Units
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of occupied housing units that are renter-occupied.
indicators.description: Renters may have less control over mitigation measures and face greater displacement risk after events.

indicators.label: Overcrowded Units
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of occupied housing units with more than one person per room.
indicators.description: Crowded housing can make it harder to shelter safely during hazards and to find suitable alternative housing.

categories.label: Economic Stability & Resources
categories.description: Economic and housing conditions that influence the ability to prepare for, absorb, and recover from climate-related events.

indicators.label: Below 100% Federal Poverty Line
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population with income below 100% of the federal poverty level.
indicators.description: Income constraints can limit access to resources needed to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters.

indicators.label: Below 150% Federal Poverty Line
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population with income below 150% of the federal poverty level.
indicators.description: Income constraints can limit access to resources needed to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters.

indicators.label: Below 200% Federal Poverty Line
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population with income below 200% of the federal poverty level.
indicators.description: Income constraints can limit access to resources needed to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters.

indicators.metric: POVERTY STATUS IN THE PAST 12 MONTHS Population for whom poverty status is determined Below 100 percent of the poverty level
indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Below 100% Federal Poverty Line
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population on Hawaiian homelands with income below 100% of the federal poverty level.
indicators.description: Income constraints can limit access to resources needed to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters.

indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Below 150% Federal Poverty Line
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population on Hawaiian homelands with income below 150% of the federal poverty level.
indicators.description: Income constraints can limit access to resources needed to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters.

indicators.label: Without Health Insurance
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of civilian noninstitutionalized population without health insurance.
indicators.description: Uninsured individuals may have reduced access to medical care during and after hazards.

categories.label: Population and Household Structure
categories.description: Population age distribution and household composition relevant to climate preparedness, evacuation needs, and caregiving capacity.

indicators.label: Aged 5 Years and Under
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population under the age of 5.
indicators.description: Young children have specific caregiving and evacuation needs that increase household vulnerability.

indicators.label: Aged 17 Years and Under
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population under the age of 18.
indicators.description: Children and adolescents may require additional support during evacuation, sheltering, and recovery, which can increase household vulnerability.

indicators.label: Aged 65 Years and Older
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population aged 65 and over.
indicators.description: Older adults can have mobility, health, and social care needs that affect hazard preparedness, evacuation, and recovery.

indicators.label: Living Alone
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households where householder lives alone.
indicators.description: Single-occupant households may have reduced social support and face higher isolation during hazards.

indicators.label: Single Parent Households
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households with one parent and children.
indicators.description: Single caregivers may face additional challenges managing evacuation, childcare, and recovery.

indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Aged 5 Years and Under
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population under the age of 5 living on Hawaiian homelands.
indicators.description: Young children have specific caregiving and evacuation needs that increase household vulnerability.

indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Aged 17 Years and Under
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population under the age of 18 living on Hawaiian homelands.
indicators.description: Children and adolescents may require additional support during evacuation, sheltering, and recovery, which can increase household vulnerability.

indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Aged 65 Years and Older
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population aged 65 and over living on Hawaiian homelands.
indicators.description: Older adults can have mobility, health, and social care needs that affect hazard preparedness, evacuation, and recovery.

categories.label: Social Context and Access
categories.description: Social and linguistic factors that can limit access to climate information, services, and recovery resources.

indicators.metric: Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone
indicators.label: Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander Population
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population identifying as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander.
indicators.description: Historical and structural inequities can contribute to differences in exposure to hazards and access to resources needed for preparedness and recovery.

indicators.label: Asian Population
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population identifying as Asian.
indicators.description: Historical and structural inequities can contribute to differences in exposure to hazards and access to resources needed for preparedness and recovery.

indicators.label: Black or African American Population
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population identifying as Black or African American.
indicators.description: Historical and structural inequities can contribute to differences in exposure to hazards and access to resources needed for preparedness and recovery.

indicators.label: White Population
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population identifying as White.
indicators.description: Historical and structural inequities can contribute to differences in exposure to hazards and access to resources needed for preparedness and recovery.

indicators.label: Two or More Races
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of population identifying with two or more races.
indicators.description: Historical and structural inequities can contribute to differences in exposure to hazards and access to resources needed for preparedness and recovery.

indicators.label: Limited English Proficiency
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households with limited English proficiency.
indicators.description: Language barriers can reduce access to warnings, assistance, and recovery information.

indicators.metric: LANGUAGE SPOKEN AT HOME AND ABILITY TO SPEAK ENGLISH Population 5 years and over Speak language other than English Speak English less than very well
indicators.label: Hawaiian Homelands - Limited English Proficiency
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households on Hawaiian homelands with limited English proficiency.
indicators.description: Language barriers can reduce access to warnings, assistance, and recovery information.

categories.label: Access to Critical Resources
categories.description: Access to essential services and systems that support climate information, response, and recovery.

indicators.label: Households Without Internet Access
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households without internet access.
indicators.description: Lack of internet access can reduce access to information and resources for hazard preparedness, response, and recovery.

indicators.label: Households Without a Computer or Smartphone
indicators.calculationDescription: Percentage of households without a computer or smartphone.
indicators.description: Limited access to digital devices can reduce access to information and resources for hazard preparedness, response, and recovery.
